text:
Alex Torres: Quick thread - customer X asks for 6y audit retention + searchable subset on demand. Need a clear scope for MVP vs opt-in.

Priya Singh: TL;DR: MVP should guarantee legal_hold + BYOK path + object cold store. Searchable cold index can be follow-up.

Maya Lin: Agree. Also call out restore cost/rate limits. If they expect ad-hoc searches over 6y, infra cost jumps. We should offer two modes: 
- "restore-on-demand" (pay-per-restore)
- "searchable-cold" (monthly surcharge + pre-indexing)

Carlos Vega: Technical constraints: manifest signing + WORM on object store, plus per-tenant key wrap. Rehydration pipeline needs throttles. Ballpark: restore-on-demand ~ 4-8 USD/GB (includes compute + temporary index) for small subsets, full-archive restore much higher.

Priya Singh: Pricing model thought: base plan covers up to 90d hot + 1y metadata. Anything beyond moves to enterprise addon with BYOK and long-term archive fees. Legal hold should always override TTL and must be logged.

RetentionBot: [system] Policy draft uploaded by Alex Torres. Running verification (checks: legal_hold_override, byok_flag, manifest_presence).

Maya Lin: UX note: make legal_hold API idempotent and require a justification field + requestor email. Removal must require Legal approval (audit record).

Alex Torres: Example policy template for RFC:
```yaml
retention_profiles:
  default:
    hot_days: 90
    metadata_years: 1
    cold_years: 0
  longterm_archive:
    hot_days: 365
    metadata_years: 2
    cold_years: 6
    byok_allowed: true
    legal_hold: optional
    searchable_cold: false
```

Carlos Vega: For searchable_cold=true we need pre-index step and reserved index budget. Suggest pilot only for 1-2 customers initially.

Priya Singh: Launch checklist (MVP):
- API: apply/remove legal_hold (with justification)
- Storage: cold WORM + manifest signing
- Security: BYOK support (wrap/unwrap) + escrow logging
- Ops: restore runbook + SLA (subset <12h, full archive <72h)
- Legal: removal workflow + audit recording

Maya Lin: Add monitoring: restore queue length, rehydration errors, retrieval cost spikes. Alert when restore cost > threshold.

Alex Torres: Decision needed by EOW for roadmap slot. Proposal: ship MVP as listed, make searchable cold a Q4 add-on pilot. Any objections?

Priya Singh: No objections. I'll write RFC and include cost sims and two pricing options (pay-per-restore vs monthly searchable surcharge).

Carlos Vega: I'll prototype manifest + rehydrate script and add rough perf numbers to RFC.

RetentionBot: [system] RFC created: /docs/retention/rfc-longterm-archive-draft.md

Alex Torres: Thanks team. I'll mark this as "Retention: long-term archive MVP (BYOK + legal_hold)" on the board and tag Priya/Carlos for owners.
